# EnterpriseGlue v0.28.3 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.28.2`.

## Highlights

- **developer-workflows:** Updates staging delivery guidance for signed retained runtimes, the current retirement plan contract, and post-route residual pruning recovery.

## User and administrator impact

- Staging retirement guidance no longer relies on a remembered retained release version or Node's strip-only TypeScript parser.
- A failure after sole-route publication can resume through an exact incident-bound residual cleanup without replaying completed lifecycle effects.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Reinstall version 0.1.11 of the EnterpriseGlue development-workflows plugin after merging this change.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The guidance limits post-route recovery to the exact failed run, retained lock generation, signed runtime and original UID/resourceVersion-bound residuals.

## Documentation

- Updates the staging-delivery skill and maintained workflow-plugin guide.

## Known limitations

- Executable recovery identities remain fixed in the independently maintained EnterpriseGlue Cloud repository.

## Rollback

- Revert the plugin guidance and version bump; this does not alter deployed Cloud resources.

## Validation evidence

- Run the bundled plugin tests, official Codex skill and plugin validators, documentation-boundary guard, and release-note validation.
